name: challenge
doc: A skill check: press the key while the needle is in the zone. Superset of ox skillCheck. Drawn by `skill-check`. Resolves true when every round passed, false otherwise.

difficulty.doc: One round, or a sequence that must all pass.

keys.doc: Allowed keys; each round picks one at random. Default {'E'}. Other keys are ignored when given, fail the round otherwise (ox).

meta.doc: Library-specific extras an adapter carries through and a renderer may honour (okok `kind`, mythic `style`, an esx picture…). Never validated.
